explore.title: How Waseet works
explore.subtitle: AI verifies the work; a fixed policy — not the AI — moves the money.

create.title: Create & agree
create.body: A buyer describes the work. The AI drafts an acceptance checklist, and both parties confirm it before any money moves.

fund.title: Fund the escrow
fund.body: The buyer pays through PayPal. The money is captured into the platform account and held — it is not sent to the seller.

deliver.title: Deliver & verify
deliver.body: The seller submits the work. The AI fetches it and checks it against the confirmed checklist.

settle.title: Release or dispute
settle.body: A confident pass auto-releases to the seller. Anything else goes to a human reviewer with the money still held.

decide.title: Decide, don't disburse
decide.body: The agents read the deal and judge the work. They can never move money — a deterministic policy does that.

gate.title: Confidence gate
gate.body: Auto-release only on a clear pass at or above the confidence threshold, with no failed criterion and no buyer contest.

failsafe.title: Fail safe, not open
failsafe.body: A fail, low confidence, an unreadable response or a contest all route to a dispute, with the funds held.

bounded.title: Bounded payouts
bounded.body: Every payout is capped at the deal amount and pinned to the named seller, whatever the deliverable claims.
